config.enabled.name: Enable Grid Menu
config.enabled.description: Replace the vanilla minecart destination list with the grid travel menu. Turn off to restore the vanilla dialogue (e.g. to rule out a conflict with another mod).
config.maxRowsPerPage.name: Max Rows Per Page
config.maxRowsPerPage.description: Maximum grid rows per page (the grid is up to 4 columns wide). 'Auto' fits as many rows as the window allows, up to 5.
config.showCurrentDestination.name: Show Current Stop
config.showCurrentDestination.descriptio: Show the stop you're boarding from as a greyed-out card instead of hiding it, so destinations keep the same position in the grid everywhere. Fixes the vanilla quirk where the list order shifts depending on where you board.
config.rememberLastDestination.name: Remember Last Destination
config.rememberLastDestination.descripti: Reopen the menu on the page of the stop you last traveled to, and snap to it when using a controller.
config.enableFavorites.name: Favorites
config.enableFavorites.description: Star stops with right-click (or X on a controller). Favorites float to the top rows of the grid, and the star button beside the close button switches to a favorites-only view. Stored per save in the mod folder, never in the save file.
config.openToFavorites.name: Open to Favorites
config.openToFavorites.description: When this network has any favorites, the menu opens in the favorites-only view; the star button switches back to all stops.
config.showSearchBox.name: Show Search Box
config.showSearchBox.description: Show the search field above the grid that filters destinations as you type (names and region labels). On a controller, select it to open the on-screen keyboard.
config.includeBuiltCarts.name: Built Carts as Destinations
config.includeBuiltCarts.description: Show constructed minecart buildings (like Better Things' buildable minecart) as free destinations wherever they were placed, with arrival right beside the cart. Stops near an existing destination are skipped to avoid duplicates.
menu.noFavorites: No favorites yet. Right-click a stop (or press X on a controller) to star it.
config.showMapPreviews.name: Show Map Previews
config.showMapPreviews.description: Show a world-map snippet of each destination under its name.
config.liveMapFallback.name: Render Missing Previews
config.liveMapFallback.description: For destinations with no world-map data (some modded locations), render a small snapshot of the actual map instead of showing a placeholder.
config.renderedPreviewsOnly.name: Rendered Previews Only
config.renderedPreviewsOnly.description: Show a live render of each destination's actual map instead of the world-map art. Renders are created once per location per day and cached; world-map art remains the fallback for maps that can't be rendered.
config.renderedPreviewZoom.name: Rendered Preview Zoom
config.renderedPreviewZoom.description: Zoom for rendered map previews. 100% letterboxes the whole map into the cell; higher values crop closer around the arrival spot.
config.detailedRenders.name: Detailed Renders
config.detailedRenders.description: Rendered previews also draw buildings, trees, placed objects and characters, like a tiny screenshot, instead of bare map tiles. A bit slower on the first render of each map per day; cache size is unchanged.
config.detailedRenderCharacters.name: Characters in Detailed Renders
config.detailedRenderCharacters.descript: Include villagers, animals and farmers in detailed snapshots. Turn off for scenery-only renders.
config.showRegionSubtitles.name: Region Subtitles
config.showRegionSubtitles.description: Show the area's world-map name as a small strip over each preview. Hidden automatically when the area has no label or it matches the destination's own title.
config.timeOfDayTint.name: Time-of-Day Tint
config.timeOfDayTint.description: Tint rendered previews with the current light: outdoor maps get the full day, night and weather tint, interiors a softer version. Applied while drawing the cached snapshot, so it costs nothing and never re-renders.
config.previewZoom.name: World-Map Preview Zoom
config.previewZoom.description: How zoomed-in the world-map previews are. 1.0 matches the in-game map screen's own scale.
config.showPrices.name: Show Ticket Prices
config.showPrices.description: Show the ticket price on destinations that charge a fee.
config.dimUnaffordable.name: Dim Unaffordable Destinations
config.dimUnaffordable.description: Grey out destinations you can't currently afford. They stay selectable; the vanilla purchase dialogue still handles the actual payment.
config.prevPageKeys.name: Previous Page
config.prevPageKeys.description: Keys/buttons that flip to the previous page while the menu is open. Keyboard arrow keys only apply when not navigating with a controller.
config.nextPageKeys.name: Next Page
config.nextPageKeys.description: Keys/buttons that flip to the next page while the menu is open. Keyboard arrow keys only apply when not navigating with a controller.
config.verboseLogging.name: Verbose Logging
config.verboseLogging.description: Write detailed menu/preview diagnostics to the SMAPI log. Only enable when debugging an issue.
